# App Attest test fixture

`attestation-production.json` comes unchanged from the [node-app-attest v1.0.1 test suite](https://github.com/uebelack/node-app-attest/blob/cfda37e1711c35a11b17fda8fb059537e8e41c7b/test/fixtures/attestation-production.json)
and is covered by the adjacent MIT license.

The fixture is for the upstream example app. It contains the signed
attestation, public key identifier, and historical challenge. The verifier
test uses a fixed date within the certificates' validity window.
